# Technical Documentation
Document verified behavior, source owners, contracts, setup, tests, and deployment boundaries. Update directly related documentation only. Keep QR, Test Mode isolation, offline behavior, and no-unapproved-deployment rules explicit. Mark unexecuted or environment-dependent procedures clearly. Avoid copying secrets or production data.
